rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Scultone, the serpent-like reptilian Scultone of the Sardinian Golgo chasm legend. Native square PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: one large reptilian serpent head with two eyes and a long limbless coiling serpent body; no invented wings, horns or legs; jaws parted [u-scultone-c01, u-scultone-c05, u-scultone-c08]
MOMENT: THRUST its head toward the viewer from the black mouth of the chasm, muscular coil gripping near rocks
POWER: no visible eye beam: the deadly gaze is expressed by direct stare alone; gravel dislodges through body movement only [u-scultone-c02, u-scultone-c09]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tight foreshortened framing; no invented gigantic size
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single slanting warm sunset shaft, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light
SURFACE: wet overlapping serpent scales, broken limestone and shrub twigs
SETTING: Su Sterru chasm on the Golgo plateau, sparse shrub edges [u-scultone-c04, u-scultone-c08]
MOOD: imposing and awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented character; never cute, calm or decorative. The creature itself dominates and remains striking at 200 pixels.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, coloured magic mist or energy ribbons. Bracketed claim IDs are instructions, never visible text.
depicted_variant: Su Sterru serpent account rather than the modern comic basilisk.

visual_requirements.description: Deadly gaze represented without invented rays

aura: Danger comes from lethal direct gaze and serpent emerging from its chasm (u-scultone-c02, u-scultone-c08, u-scultone-c09).
artistic_choices: Limbless serpent depiction follows explicit serpent sources. Slate-brown scales and dusk are editorial. No gaze beam, petrification or victim introduced; death power remains a threatening stare.

visual_review.notes: Native and200px viewed; all seven checks pass. One serpent head/two eyes, single continuous limbless coiled scaled body emerging from deep Golgo chasm. Strong forward open-jaw lunge, real dislodged gravel only. Deadly gaze expressed by stare, no eye ray or petrification. No modern comic basilisk design, added limbs, horns, text or gore. At 200px head and threatening action dominant.

root_visual_review.notes: Serpentine dragon rising from the Golgo chasm with jaws open and a fixed deadly stare; no rays.
